_comment: MENDELEEV S5 row 3b full-FT recovery AND its fair-scratch twin in ONE rental (one 3b pair load), mirroring mdl_rec_r512_row2-10B. The twin is not optional: spec 6.6's 'dose too weak' VOID rule is defined only against a fair-scratch arm run under the IDENTICAL recipe and dose ladder, so without it row 3b's REC-full can be neither voided nor validated — and 3b:REC-full-scratch was named by no manifest at all (matrix_check --coverage: VAST-NO-MFST), i.e. it had no launch path on either lane. Spec 11.2: exact fp32 Adam 3-4B -> 1x80 GB class. Download-mode fast-pipe filter, in-job hub download, smoke cell first, no baked weights. {BEH_METRICS_S3} is substituted at rent time with the row's behaviour-cell metrics.json S3 URL (dose-0 identity, spec 6.6); scripts/matrix_launch.py prints the filled manifest path.
